allowed_inputs: posed RGB frames from 3RScan sequence payload
registered depth frames from the same sequence payload
camera pose and intrinsics from the sequence payload
M17 prompt labels and prompt set id
GroundingDINO boxes, labels, and confidence scores
SAM masks produced from the same RGB frame and detector boxes
blocked_inputs: 3DSSG object instance ids during proposal generation
M17 evaluation target ids during proposal generation
future frames outside the selected scan/frame budget
heldout matching labels or target locations as detector prompts beyond the fixed M17 prompt set

comparison_policy.primary_comparison: same scan/frame subset versus current bbox-depth GroundingDINO route
success_signal: matched targets are not lower than the same-subset bbox-depth route or mean matched centroid error decreases
false-positive rows do not increase on the same subset
unsupported_after_pass: claim that SAM solves detector label false positives

long_running_policy.tmux_template: ts=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S); tmux new-session -d -s e003_m49_grounded_sam "cd /home/yoohyun/research2 && mkdir -p logs && python experiments/E003_perception_noise_expansion/tools/run_m49_grounded_sam_smoke.py --out-dir experiments/E003_perception_noise_expansion/artifacts/E003-M49_grounded_sam_smoke_v0 --max-scans 1 --max-frames-per-scan 2 --max-labels 12 > logs/${ts}_e003_m49_grounded_sam_smoke.log 2>&1"

mask_backprojection_steps: run GroundingDINO as the current backend does
run SAM with each detector box as a box prompt
resize mask to depth frame coordinates
keep finite positive depth pixels inside the mask
apply robust median/MAD or percentile depth trimming
backproject valid mask pixels with intrinsics and pose
write mask centroid and optional sampled support points
preserve the existing real_proposal_prediction_jsonl_v0 required fields
run the existing validator and M21 matcher

optional_fields_added.purpose: separate mask-depth geometry from previous box-depth geometry
record the segmentation backend used after GroundingDINO boxes
valid positive depth pixels inside the mask
valid depth pixels divided by mask area
freeze robust depth filtering and centroid estimation policy
paired diagnostic centroid from previous bbox-depth route
optional path to sampled world points for later debugging without bloating JSONL

smoke_scope.reason: verify schema, depth/mask geometry, and matcher compatibility before any long multi-scan run
